wedo_instance.description: The metabolic bridge for ingesting, tracking, and resolving remote intent from Pull Requests.

meta.philosophy: Conscious Duality: The shared thread of attention between Remote Intent (Rider) and Local Execution (Machinery).
meta.instruction: When a remote PR is identified, ingest every '- [ ] WeDo:' task from the diff into a new instance of this file in the day's chrono-fractal.

protocols.name: Audit Scrutiny
protocols.rule: Every task must be granularly documented with its source PR URL and a forensic report of its localhost resolution.

protocols.name: Hostile Environment Verification
protocols.rule: The machinery MUST verify all artifacts on the localhost. Remote-only tasks must be flagged as USER_REQUIRED.

examples.description: Root README Physics Dichotomy: Explain latency as physical unfolding, referencing the measurement system.
Refine Fracture Definition: Clarify forking as joyous ecological sophistication vs growing pain.

tasks.description: Diff Analysis: Scan the remote PR diff and present the raw intent to the Lead Partner.
OPERATOR SIGN-OFF: Present the summarized intent for Human review. I CANNOT proceed until you explicitly approve the execution of these specific WeDo IDs.
ID Assignment: Assign unique WeDo IDs (e.g., GEM-PR1-01) to each approved task.
Localhost Execution: Perform the approved modifications on the sovereign filesystem.
Audit Report: Generate a Synthesis Report meeting the Audit Scrutiny standard.
